settings.title: Moderation settings
settings.lead: What the network reviews before publication, section by section, and the words that send content to review. Reserved to the network administration; every setting and every word carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.
settings.restricted: Moderation settings are reserved to the network administration.

defaults.title: Without a network setting
defaults.preReviewOff: No review before publication: content appears as soon as it is written.
defaults.preReviewOn: Review before publication: every piece of content waits for a moderator.
defaults.links_one: Beyond {{count}} link, content goes to review: it is not refused.
defaults.links_other: Beyond {{count}} links, content goes to review: it is not refused.
defaults.writes_one: Beyond {{count}} write in {{window}}, across all sections, the next one also goes to review.
defaults.writes_other: Beyond {{count}} writes in {{window}}, across all sections, the next one also goes to review.
defaults.terms: Content containing a blocked word goes to review.
defaults.source: These are the defaults of the ANTSIA engine, read as it applies them. They apply to every section without a setting, except the content reviewed by default, listed separately, and the mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit and jobs sections, published without any rule until a setting is set for them.

held.title: Reviewed by default in DIASPORALE
held.lead: Until a setting is set for their section, this content waits for a moderator before it appears:
held.reviews: reviews of a service (section “Review of a service”);
held.reviewReplies: a page's replies to a review (section “Page reply to a review”);
held.note: A setting on one of these sections makes this content follow that setting. On “Event” and “Post”, it also applies to personal events and to every post.

heldNote.associationEvents: Association events stay reviewed by default until a setting is set.
heldNote.eventGallery: Additions to an event gallery stay reviewed by default until a setting is set.

without.defaults: Without a setting: the engine defaults apply.
without.held: Without a setting: every piece of content in this section waits for a moderator before it appears.
without.unchecked: Without a setting: published as soon as it is written and moderated after a report, with no link cap, no pace limit and no blocked words.

surfaces.title: By section
surfaces.lead: The sections of DIASPORALE. A setting replaces, for its section, the rule without a setting; it cannot be removed, only changed.

policy.writes_one: At most {{count}} write in {{window}}; beyond that, review.
policy.writes_other: At most {{count}} writes in {{window}}; beyond that, review.

sheet.title: Setting: {{surface}}
sheet.description: Review before publication, link cap and pace for this section. The setting carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.
sheet.preReviewHint: Every piece of content in this section waits for a moderator before it appears.
sheet.maxLinksHint: Beyond it, content goes to review; from {{linksMin}} to {{linksMax}}.
sheet.maxWrites: Writes at most within the window
sheet.maxWritesHint: Beyond it, the next one goes to review; from {{writesMin}} to {{writesMax}}.

liftsHeld.associationEvents: Association events are reviewed by default today. This setting applies to every event, association events included: without review before publication, the next one will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.reviews: Reviews are reviewed by default today. This setting makes them follow it: without review before publication, the next review will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.reviewReplies: A page's replies to a review are reviewed by default today. This setting makes them follow it: without review before publication, the next one will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.
liftsHeld.eventGallery: Additions to an event gallery are reviewed by default today. This setting applies to every post, gallery included: without review before publication, the next addition will appear directly if it respects the link cap, the pace and the blocked words.

sheet.permanent: A setting cannot be removed once set: it can only be changed.
sheet.reasonHint: Why this setting; the reason stays in the decision log ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).

terms.title: Blocked words
terms.lead: Content containing one of these words goes to review: it is not refused. Case and accents do not matter, and the word is also matched inside other words. The network keeps {{termsMax}} at most.
terms.waveNote: The mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit and jobs sections only read blocked words once a setting is set for them.
terms.emptyBody: The network has not blocked any word yet.
terms.removeBody: Content containing this word will no longer go to review for that reason. The removal carries a reason and is written to the engine's decision log.
terms.termHint: From {{termMin}} to {{termMax}} characters, case and accents removed.
terms.reasonHint: Why this word; the reason stays in the decision log ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).

errors.moderation_desk_links_bounds: The link cap goes from {{linksMin}} to {{linksMax}}, as a whole number.
errors.moderation_desk_writes_bounds: The pace allows {{writesMin}} to {{writesMax}} writes, as a whole number.
errors.moderation_desk_window_bounds: The pace window goes from {{windowMin}} to {{windowMax}} minutes, as a whole number.
errors.moderation_desk_term_length: A blocked word has {{termMin}} to {{termMax}} characters, case and accents removed.
errors.moderation_desk_terms_full: The network already keeps {{termsMax}} blocked words: unblock one before adding another.
